steps.detail: That is the shape of most language model code: one config object built once and passed everywhere (Block, CRNN, DNN, DepthWiseSeparableConvBlock). None of it is out of reach — Import can take a Setup block that builds the config, and then these classes import like any other. A scout cannot write that block, because guessing the values would make every number it reported meaningless.
